content.short: Polygonscan is a Polygon blockchain explorer.
content.description: Polygonscan, launched by Polygon in June 2021, serves as a Polygon blockchain explorer. Users can search for Polygon transactions, track activity, and inspect blocks and addresses. Developers can access block explorer data and related services through the PolygonScanDeveloper APIs, using GET or POST requests to retrieve information. Polygonscan stands as a leading blockchain explorer, search tool, API provider, and analytics platform for the Polygon ecosystem.
